# Yashwant Kotipalli

> I build AI infrastructure for GPU fleets at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. My work spans fleet health, diagnostic workflows, repair orchestration and communication across substrate and overlay networks. Previously, I owned distributed services at Amazon ReCommerce. My current focus is inference optimization and scaling: scheduling, KV-cache behavior and latency–throughput trade-offs.

Public profile last reviewed: 2026-10-27.

## Public work

- [Persistence, concurrency and stale frame state.](https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/pull/1391): Shipped in v1.30.0.0. Contributed three browser-runtime reliability fixes covering console-log persistence, concurrent state-file writes and stale iframe references. Credited in the release changelog.
- [A one-second boundary in cron validation.](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81731): Merged contribution. Corrected a validation edge case that could rebase a valid future cron slot. The merged patch adds regression coverage for exact-second schedules.
- [Durable work, bounded authority.](https://github.com/yashkot007/accord): Independent experimental prototype. An independent TypeScript agent workspace exploring durable task history, versioned updates, reviewed context and scoped permissions.

Inference tools and mechanisms are listed in the October 2026 résumé. This inventory does not establish production inference deployment, kernel implementations or measured serving results.

Current technical focus and résumé-listed skills. No public inference-serving benchmark, profiling report or kernel implementation is available as of this review; no serving speedup or production serving ownership is claimed.
